Players Committee card image of [[The Dark Path (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on table. Add one [Dark Side Force] icon at each site where you have a 'Hatred' card. Once per game, target two battleground sites you occupy; one at a time, stack top card of your Lost Pile face down (as a 'Hatred' card) at those locations. [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/thedarkpath.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Dark/large/thedarkpath.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
